bug_info.bug_desc: In the combinational `always_comb` block, `valid_o[i]` is assigned only when `itt_out[i].valid` is true. When that condition is false, the signal has no assignment on that combinational path, so synthesis/static-analysis tools infer a latch to preserve the previous value. This violates the intended fully-combinational output assignment style and can leave stale valid indications instead of cleanly deasserting the output for ports that do not produce a trace packet.
bug_info.fix_hint: Give `valid_o[i]` a default value before the conditional trace-packet assignment in the `always_comb` loop. The signal should be driven on every combinational path, with the default deasserted value overridden only when a valid trace packet is produced.
